scene: You glide out of the brass revolving door into Puzzle Box Hotel.
picture: A flat side view of the grand hotel lobby. On the far left stands the brass revolving door. At the left sits a mahogany front desk with a shiny bronze bell. The player stands in roller skates left of centre. At centre stands a cubic bellhop robot. On the far right, wooden stairs slide along tracks.
shown: a shiny bronze service bell on the mahogany front desk at the left
a cubic brass robot holding a room key at the centre
a wooden staircase sliding along brass wall tracks on the far right
